Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 89, Line 7: "You should receive a Form 1099-G showing in box 1 the total unemployment compensation paid to you in 2025. Report this amount on line 7", reduced by program contributions ("If you made contributions to a governmental unemployment compensation program and you aren't itemizing deductions, reduce the amount you report on line 7 by those contributions") and 2025 overpayments repaid. With no compensation paid in 2025, line 7 is zero and neither s1.uc_repaid nor the s1.uc_unsupported screen is needed for it; a repayment over $3,000 of earlier-year compensation is not a line 7 amount (p525 p. 36, Repayments). The project asks both only when s1.has_uc (s1.uc_paid above zero). The candidate drops that guard and declares the screen on every return, which after BUG-0245 asks about contributions "in 2025 or any earlier year ... including amounts withheld from your wages", so it would refuse, for example, any worker in a state that withholds employee unemployment contributions, with no compensation at all. Triage (executable-triage-v2, uncapped scratch rerun of the current reply (1,382 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 671 partial records; 2,553 comparisons per line); record triage/s1.deepseek.json): 1,388 agree; 1,104 candidate-unknown (1,082 on s1.uc_unsupported, 22 on s1.uc_repaid, all with s1.has_uc false and project $0.00); 61 candidate-refuses on s1.uc_unsupported, 59 with s1.has_uc false and project $0.00 (18 on completed returns: classm.f1040.6, classm.f1040.6.deepseek, classm.f5695.2, classm.f5695.2.deepseek and partials of those bases) and 2 partial records withholding s1.uc_paid. No value differences. The fix (BUG-0245) widens only the screen, which the project still reaches only with compensation; it introduces no error in the line. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 91, Line 8c: "Enter any canceled debt. Canceled debt may be shown in box 2 of Form 1099-C. However, part or all of your income from cancellation of debt may be nontaxable. See Pub. 4681". With no canceled debt, line 8c is zero and the exceptions-and-exclusions screen is not needed; the project asks s1.cod_unsupported only when s1.cod_any is true and the amount is positive (s1.cod_refused; amb.2025.cod_fully_taxable). The BUG-0244 rewording ("deductible interest or other deductible debt"; p4681 p. 6, Deductible Debt, "If you use the cash method of accounting, you don't realize income from the cancellation of debt if the payment of the debt would have been a deductible expense") only widens the screen in the refusing direction and introduces no error. Project stands.
